headline: PIT @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 3.58 at TOR 4.72, with a projected total of 8.30. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: PIT moved -1.28 runs while TOR moved +0.50, changing the projected margin by -1.78 runs. The projected total fell -0.78, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Dylan Cease has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jesús Sánchez, Spencer Horwitz, Konnor Griffin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Kazuma Okamoto, Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
